court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Suresh Kacharu Aher And Another vs Dipak Bhaurao Deshmukh

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Suresh Kacharu Aher And Another (husband, wife, plaintiff)

facts_of_case: Matrimonial dispute between parties; RCC No.641/2023 pending on file of JMFC, Ahmednagar; other four proceedings pending before Court at Niphad.

legal_principles.principle: Burden lies on the party seeking transfer of a case to establish sufficient reasons for such transfer.
legal_principles.held: The fact of pendency of said proceedings at Niphad has not been denied by the non-applicant. The burden lies on the applicants to establish sufficient reasons for transferring the present proceeding from the file of the learned JMFC, Ahmednagar to the file of the learned JMFC, Niphad.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking transfer of a case must establish sufficient reasons for such transfer.
legal_principles.held: The applicants prayed for transfer of RCC No.641/2023 pending on the file of the learned JMFC, Ahmednagar to the file of learned JMFC, Niphad on the ground that the RCC No.641/2023 is based on the incident for which the NCR No. 1142/2023 is registered with Topkhana Police Station, Ahmednagar against the present non-applicant.

outcome.final_order: RCC No.641/2023 transferred to file of learned JMFC, Niphad with immediate effect.
